text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. Machine learning is a key part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning, which uses artificial neural networks, is an advanced form of machine learning. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. For example, it helps us find information online, suggests films to watch, and powers voice assistants on our phones. It is also used in hospitals and banks to work faster and more accurately. AI is changing the way we live and work.
